adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Admin::GroupsController#add_members and #remove_member, both using `Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)` (will raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` if invalid) and `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by `group.save`. The new specs in `.remove_member` only cover automatic-group rejection and successful removal; they do not cover removing a non-member user_id or invalid group_id. Also, because `group.users.delete(user_id)` executes the deletion immediately (not contingent on `group.save`), a hypothetical `group.save` failure would still leave the member removed while returning an error—this transactional inconsistency is a concrete edge-case concern introduced by this implementation, even if actual save failures may be rare/unknown from the diff alone.
